_about: The three Cinder AI teams. Each machine sets "team" in ~/.cinder/config.json. Teams share the repo but have different jobs, sizes and first-choice free models, so they don't make the same monsters or compete for the same free limits. All of them use free cloud models only.

A.name: Team A
A.job: Regular enemies: the soldiers, beasts and undead the player fights most, medium sized (like the hound and the ghoul), each with a clear fighting role.

B.name: Team B
B.job: Bosses and big monsters: one huge, memorable creature per round, with a signature weapon or body feature, as the centrepiece of a dungeon.

C.name: Team C
C.job: Small creatures and critters (wisps, rats, imps, beetles, ash crows), plus polishing existing models.
